notes: The second isnad begins after the dot with «حدثني محمود» (no «ح»); both routes meet at Ma'mar and the names after him are written once
«قال أخبرني سعيد بن المسيب، عن أبي هريرة» gives Sa'id and Abu Hurayra; the Prophet's account of his night journey is the saying, so the chain ends at Abu Hurayra
